offer.title: Core service — External DPO in the European Union

cards.title: Scope
cards.text: Ongoing representation and advice: risk management, policies, legal-basis assessment, privacy by design, data subject requests (DSRs), and liaison with clients/auditors.

cards.title: Deliverables
list: DPIA (Data Protection Impact Assessment), where applicable

cards.title: Outcomes
list: Faster contracting and shorter procurement cycles
Prioritized risks with clear owners and timelines
Audit-ready evidence for customer and regulator reviews
Trained team and a lightweight, sustainable maintenance cadence

process.title: From regulatory requirement to competitive advantage
process.intro: We integrate legal, engineering, and security to reduce risk without slowing product. The result is speed with real governance and audit-ready evidence.

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.desc: Map data flows, legal bases, risks, and vendor dependencies. Receive a prioritized plan by effort/impact/timeline.

steps.title: Implement
steps.desc: Controls that work: policies, RoPA, DPIA, vendor governance, transfers, 72h incidents, privacy by design, and training.

steps.title: Sustain
steps.desc: Lightweight routine: owners, quarterly cadence, change logs, and continuous evidence for audits and customers.

proofs.v: Documents and records auditors actually use: RoPA, DPIA, risk logs, decisions, and approvals linked to releases.
Consistent security/privacy responses, recognized clauses, and clear data flows accelerate procurement.
Pre-launch requirements are built into the product cycle, preventing delays and last-minute changes.
